verdict.rationale: Product discovery is a fair question for an agentic-commerce platform, so the axis applies. But the evidence covers only payment-side primitives: card enrollment, tokens, purchase-intent mandates, credential retrieval, an MCP toolkit for invoices and payment links, and Trusted Agent Protocol signatures. None of it documents an API or tool that lets an agent search products or services across merchants. TAP's 'agent-browser-auth' signature only authenticates an agent that is already browsing a merchant site; it is not a cross-merchant search capability, so it is not credited.
